title: test-plan
description: Pre-fieldwork test plan record produced for a single control test cycle. Carries scope, test objective, source criteria, population, sampling reference, walkthrough plan, design and operating procedures, evidence-request reference, clear and fail criteria, limitations, downstream consumers, and the reviewer sign-off block. Downstream consumers: control-sampling (writes back sampling_id), evidence-request-builder (writes back evidence_request_list_id), workpaper-drafter (consumes the full plan as the contract for the workpaper), qa-workpaper (reads plan and workpaper together for sufficiency).

test_id.description: Stable identifier per firm naming convention.

control_id.description: Firm control register ID for the control under test. The test plan does not invent control IDs; it consumes the firm's control inventory.

obligation_ids.description: Firm obligation register IDs the control addresses. May be one or more.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this test plan was produced.

prior_period_test_id.description: Test ID of the prior-cycle plan this cycle builds on (where applicable).

period_start.description: First day of the period under test.

period_end.description: Last day of the period under test.

business_unit.description: Name of the business unit owning the control. Role-level, not individual-level.

jurisdiction.description: Primary jurisdiction the test addresses. Multi-jurisdiction tests should list primary here and add secondary in scope_notes.

scope_statement.description: Two to three sentences. What is in scope, what is out of scope, what triggered the cycle.

source_posture.description: Source posture the testing will operate under.

role.description: Preparer role, not individual name. Examples: compliance-testing analyst, internal-audit senior, controls-testing pod lead.

reviewer.description: Reviewer must be a separate role from preparer. date_reviewed and sign_off_status are filled at the pre-fieldwork sign-off gate.

role.description: Reviewer role. Examples: compliance-testing manager, internal-audit director.

statement.description: Single statement of what the test concludes on.

criteria.description: Source criteria the test will evaluate evidence against.

source.description: Regulator and instrument (e.g., 'CFPB Reg E', 'FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual').

section.description: Section reference. Use [verify section] if unknown; do not invent.

text.description: Verbatim excerpt or paraphrase tight enough that the criterion is unambiguous.

applicability_note.description: Why this criterion applies to the population under test.

description.description: What the population is (originations during period, accounts open during period, packets due in period).

source_of_truth.description: System or report from which the population extract is taken.

period_boundaries.description: How the period defines inclusion (open during period, executed during period, action-taken during period).

stratification.description: Planned stratification for the sample (privilege tier, action-taken type, customer risk tier).

extract_integrity_check_planned.description: What the workpaper will reconcile the extract against for completeness.

sampling_id.description: Foreign key into control-sampling output. Written back by control-sampling when the sampling memo is produced separately.

inline_sample_design.description: Used when the test is small enough that sample design sits inline in the plan rather than in a separate sampling memo.

tolerable_deviation_rate.description: Format as percentage or rate, e.g., '3%' or '0% for privileged-access subset'.

scope.description: Full walkthrough, refresher walkthrough on system changes only, or skipped (with rationale and prior workpaper ID).

screens_to_inspect.description: System-of-record names, configuration screens, report runs.

design_procedures.description: Numbered procedures evaluating whether the control as designed addresses the criterion. Walkthrough-and-inspection methodology, not sample-based reperformance.

expected_evidence.description: Evidence type the procedure produces (configuration screen, policy excerpt, attestation form template, training record).

expected_observable_condition.description: What the preparer expects to observe to support a met or not-met read.

operating_procedures.description: Numbered procedures testing whether the control operated as designed during the period. Methodology per procedure.

expected_evidence_per_sample.description: Evidence type expected per sampled item (case file, system extract, attestation packet, reconciliation).

expected_observable_condition.description: What the preparer expects to observe per sample to support a success or exception read.

evidence_request_list_id.description: Foreign key into evidence-request-builder output. Written back by evidence-request-builder when the request list is produced separately.

inline_evidence_requests.description: Used when the test is small enough that the evidence request list sits inline in the plan.

pass_criteria.description: Observable condition that supports an effective read. Calibrated in second-line vocabulary (control effectiveness, not legal compliance).

fail_criteria.description: Observable condition that supports a not-effective read. Calibrated in second-line vocabulary.

tolerable_deviation_rate_reference.description: Pointer into the sampling memo or the inline_sample_design.tolerable_deviation_rate. Zero-tolerable populations named explicitly.

limitations.description: Period coverage, scope exclusions, dependencies on other in-flight reviews, reliance on prior testing.

downstream_consumers.description: Skills the plan hands off to. Naming the consumers makes the cycle's lifecycle visible at planning time.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the named reviewer to consider before pre-fieldwork sign-off.

confidence_label.description: Reflects source posture, firm-policy maturity for the control area, and any open question on the criteria. Per references/review-gates.md.

human_review_required.description: Always true. Pre-fieldwork sign-off is a hard gate; evidence pulls happen after sign-off, not before.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this plan must clear. Drawn from references/review-gates.md.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims in the plan.
